channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jeremy Lin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jeremy Lin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
When asked Friday about his Knicks fandom growing up, Towns gushed about Jeremy Lin.

“I truly want to give a shoutout to Jeremy Lin because he really made me a Knicks fan and had me at Modell’s,”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Jeremy Lin, May 30, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
“It was crazy trying to find his jersey. I have so much love for Jeremy Lin, he’s one of my favorite Knicks of all time, one of my favorite players of all time. He made me so passionate about the Knicks. It’s crazy now that I’m in this position, in this chair, talking to you guys as a Knicks player. [They] showed me the other day Jeremy Lin on social [media], for him to even mention me was kind of crazy because the love I have for him and what he’s done for me and my Knicks fandom is second to none.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Jeremy Lin, May 30, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
but Anthony offered no other explanation.

“Jeremy Lin, I’m giving you my invite to come sit on the couch,”

Carmelo Anthony on Jeremy Lin, May 19, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Fred VanVleet on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Fred VanVleet:

“I’m reading my Twitter... they killing me. They sending me death threats. They saying, 'N*gga, you suck, man. We [ __ ] hate you. [ __ ] your family. We want Jeremy Lin to play over you!' Woo woo—this, that, and the third. All this [ __ ], man.”

Fred VanVleet on Jeremy Lin, Dec 9, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
“I think he's a fabulous players but you have to be great for a long period of time. We all remember Jeremy Lin, what happened to him?”

Shaquille O'Neal on Jeremy Lin, Mar 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
D’Antoni recalled, laughing.

“I said, ‘Oh, I don’t know, Jeremy. I don’t think so, let me get back to you on that one.’”

Mike D'Antoni on Jeremy Lin, Apr 14, 2022. Source: NBC.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Steve Kerr on Jeremy Lin's social media post.

“I can't wrap my head around racism... I applaud Jeremy for speaking out.”

Steve Kerr on Jeremy Lin, Feb 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Trae Young on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
“I always tell people I’m in a lucky situation being around a team that’s rebuilding but with a really good coach and really good veterans like Jeremy Lin and guys like Vince who have been around the game,”

Trae Young on Jeremy Lin, Dec 18, 2018. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Sean Marks on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
#Nets GM Sean Marks on Jeremy Lin:

“You look at the team now, that’s what we’ve got and that’s what we’re planning on. We’re planning on going into the season with that team.”

Sean Marks on Jeremy Lin, Jul 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Atkinson on Jeremy Lin:

“We’ve just got to be really super, super-cautious. We don’t want to rush this in April, May. But I was blown away at how well he was moving, and the stuff he did yesterday.”

Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin, Apr 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
“My situation is similar to Jeremy’s, actually. Injuries had to pave the way for Linsanity. I think that’s the story of a lot of non-lottery pick guys. For them to have that opportunity, usually someone has to get hurtbecause you’re not going to promise a spot to somebody who is not of that pedigree or doesn’t have that whatever it is. There’s always a pecking order.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Jeremy Lin, Feb 13, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Kenny Atkinson told reporters Friday afternoon.

“It’s was a collaborative effort from Sean (Marks) and I, our performance team, and the group in Vancouver – plus Jeremy’s group too,”

Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin, Dec 2, 2017. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Sean Marks on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Tom Lorenzo:Sean Marks on Jeremy Lin:

“We're expecting a full recovery. We're expecting him to be back on the court this time next year.”

Sean Marks on Jeremy Lin, Oct 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @TomLorenzo.

item.title: Kenyon Martin on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Kenyon Martin:

“Do I need to remind this damn boy his last name Lin? Like, come on, man. Let’s stop it with these people. There is no way possible he would’ve made it on one of our teams with that bullshit on his head. Come on man, somebody need to tell him, like, ‘alright bro, we get it. You wanna be black.’ Like, we get it. But your last name is Lin.'”

Kenyon Martin on Jeremy Lin, Oct 5, 2017. Source: Instagram.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:D'Angelo Russell on Lin:

“He’s a great dude, a great teammate,and there’s a lot I can learn from him.”

D'Angelo Russell on Jeremy Lin, Sep 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin's importance:

“I compare to football and you have your starting quarterback. He commands the huddle.”

Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin, Mar 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
#BrooklynNetsKenny Atkinson on what Jeremy Lin means:

“More than his talent, more than his experience I just think there is a confidence”

Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin, Mar 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKerber.

item.title: Caris LeVert on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Caris LeVert on @Jeremy Lin:

“I saw him when we first came in. He was in good spirits so hopefully it's not long-term.”

Caris LeVert on Jeremy Lin, Mar 19, 2017. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:Atkinson on Lin:

“We're building his minutes up. He's not up to playing 35 minutes, and he showed some fatigue tonight.”

Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin, Mar 12, 2017. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Mike D'Antoni on whether he looks back on his time with Jeremy Lin and thinks it was kind of fun:

“It wasn't kind of fun. It was really fun. As a coach, it was fun doing it. Was really proud of him and what he has done and it couldn't happen to a better person. It goes deep. That is why you coach for a guy, moments like that and people like him.”

Mike D'Antoni on Jeremy Lin, Jan 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Brook Lopez on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Lopez said repeatedly.

“I didn't even find out about it until I read my comic book websites ... It was spot on. Great stuff. There were panels that I swear that [Pak] was behind me (with Lin and the Nets) looking at Jeremy while he drew it. And it was pretty true to his voice.”

Brook Lopez on Jeremy Lin, Dec 15, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin since #Linsanity:

“Definitely, he’s matured. I see a different maturity about him, a different confidence.”

Kenny Atkinson on Jeremy Lin, Oct 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Trevor Booker on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Booker:

“Jeremy is a tremendous player. He’s had his ups and downs, which we all do. But the Jeremy I saw last year probably had his best NBA season yet, and I’m looking forward to him just building off of that.[He can] come in, be a leader as a point guard and be very vocal to build off what he did last year.”

Trevor Booker on Jeremy Lin, Oct 10, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
“Steve is not like your traditional jet. Steve had his pace and Jeremy Lin had his pace and guys had their pace and all the point guards I ever coached had their way of doing it and those are very good players. He'll have his way. I don't know if we'll time him, 'Ok, he's fast or slow. It will be fast enough to score.”

Mike D'Antoni on Jeremy Lin, Sep 26, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jarrett Jack on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
“Ihaven’t reached out to J-Lin, but hopefully he doesn’t think it was (any bitterness on my part),”

Jarrett Jack on Jeremy Lin, Jul 30, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Minutes after leaving the main press conference room, D’Antoni brings up Jeremy Lin — unprompted — in one of his first side interviews.

“With Linsanity we had 11 games, if I’m not mistaken, where we were the No. 1 defensive team in the league (with Lin as the point guard),”

Mike D'Antoni on Jeremy Lin, Jun 2, 2016. Source: PaperCity Magazine.

item.title: Amare Stoudemire on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Amar'e Stoudemire on why Jeremy Lin didn't come back to NY:

“He was becoming a star and I don’t think everybody was pleased with that. A lot of times you gotta enjoy someone else's success. And that wasn’t the case for us during that stretch.”

Amare Stoudemire on Jeremy Lin, Feb 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Amare Stoudemire on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Amar'e Stoudemire had this interesting comment on Jeremy Lin's Knicks tenure:

“If he stayed it would've been cool. But everyone wasn't a fan of him being the new star. So he didn't stay long. But Jeremy was a great, great guy. Great teammate. He put the work in and we're proud of him to have his moment. A lot of times you gotta enjoy someone's success. And that wasn't the case for us during that stretch.”

Amare Stoudemire on Jeremy Lin, Feb 28, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Isaiah on All-Star voting:

“The voting is a popularity contest. I mean, no disrespect, you got guys like Jeremy Lin getting a lot of votes.”

Isaiah Thomas on Jeremy Lin, Jan 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Jordan saw it a successful deal,

“We just got Jeremy Lin, who I think is going to be our biggest acquisition. His penetration, his shooting capability, his point guard savvy,he can really pass the basketball, his energy about the game of basketball something,”

Michael Jordan on Jeremy Lin, Oct 10, 2015. Source: Xinhua.
